title: scarcode: reproduction package for "Scrambling, not athermality, protects quantum information under generic measurement: chaotic states outperform quantum many-body scar codes"

creators.name: Wakaura, Hikaru

creators.affiliation: QIRI (Quantum Integrated Research Institute Inc.), Tokyo, Japan

description: Reproduction package for the paper Scrambling, not athermality, protects quantum information under generic measurement: chaotic states outperform quantum many-body scar codes (H. Wakaura and T. Tanimae). Contains the scarcode Python package (PXP and spin-1 Schecter–Iadecola models, monitored-trajectory reference-qubit coherent information, static Knill–Laflamme diagnostics, emergent-su(2) Casimir), the paper-reproduction drivers, a pytest benchmark suite, all figure data, and the LaTeX manuscript source. One command regenerates every figure. Main finding: under every generic measurement, chaotic thermal codes protect quantum information better than quantum-many-body-scar codes; an exactly solvable model isolates the Casimir variance as the single control parameter. MIT-licensed. Source repository: https://github.com/deeptell-inc/chaosec
notes: Software reproduction package archived alongside the article submitted to PRX Quantum. Regenerate results with `pip install -e .` then the drivers in scripts/.
